svg.title: POS-Pulse system architecture
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram showing POS-Pulse as the focal node at centre, with a READ-DOWN data flow bringing catalogue snapshots from Data-Pulse-2 into the local SQLite read model, and a CAPTURE-UP sale outbox flow rising back to Data-Pulse-2. Cashier UI and barcode scanner feed the local catalogue search; finalised sales flow through the sale outbox toward the backend. Data-Pulse-2 sits above, connecting onward to the ERPNext Connector and ERPNext.
svg.text: External ERP — no direct POS link
READ-DOWN — Catalogue snapshot/delta: backend → local SQLite
CAPTURE-UP — Finalized sales: local outbox → backend
ERP chain — DP2 → Connector → ERPNext (no direct POS → ERP)
works without network · catalogue cached locally
